patterns.note: Complex, full-width line-art diagrams and code blocks are integrated directly into the content flow, often spanning the full width of the page and serving as primary visual explainers.
A strong typographic hierarchy is established with large, bold, dark orange sans-serif headings, a more subdued sans-serif for body text, and a distinct monospace font for all code examples.
A warm, limited palette of off-white background, dark orange/brown for primary text and headings, and a brighter orange for accents and line-art diagrams.
A simple, fixed header containing the logo and navigation remains at the top of the viewport without any visual transformation upon scrolling.
Each major content section is introduced by a prominent, bold, dark orange heading and is often immediately followed by a large, illustrative diagram or code block that visually explains the concept.

technique_notes: Implement a fixed header that maintains its position and visual style at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll, providing persistent navigation.

Integrate intricate, full-width line-art diagrams and extensive code snippets as core visual elements, using them to illustrate complex technical concepts directly within the content flow rather than relying on traditional imagery.

Establish a clear typographic system with a large, bold sans-serif for primary headings, a more subtle sans-serif for body text, and a distinct monospace font for all code examples, ensuring visual separation and readability for technical content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear hierarchy, legible body text, and distinct monospace code blocks.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (buttons and chat bubbles have slightly rounded corners).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between sections, ample padding around diagrams and text blocks).

standout: The site's standout feature is its highly technical and illustrative approach, using intricate, full-width line-art diagrams and extensive code examples as primary visual content rather than relying on typical imagery or illustrations. This creates a unique, almost academic or documentation-like aesthetic that deeply integrates technical explanations into the design.
